headline: SDP @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.57 at WSN 3.23, with a projected total of 6.80. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: SDP moved -2.30 runs while WSN moved -1.05, changing the projected margin by -1.25 runs. The projected total fell -3.35, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Michael King has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., James Wood, Daylen Lile, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
